verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Mercado Pago's own documented ability to create test users and manage their funds to validate payment flows, exposed through its MCP server. Nothing shows a full sandbox that mirrors production, or test cards for specific scenarios. missing for 10: documented sandbox/test-mode environment mirroring production, test card numbers, decline-scenario test cards, dispute/chargeback simulation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: Create test users and manage their funds to validate payment flows.
